title: The Bug and the Bun
lines: Bob got on the big bus.
A bun and a fig sat in the bag.
A bug got in and bit the bun!
"Do not nip the bun!" said Bob.
But the bug got a big bit of it.
A man on the bus got a cup.
The man did tip the bug in the cup.
Bob got the bun. The bug got a bit.

questions.ask: What got in and bit the bun?
questions.listenFor: A bug. It is right there in the story. If your child guesses, point at the line with the word bug and read it again.

questions.ask: How did the man on the bus help?
questions.listenFor: He tipped the bug into a cup. Listen for the cup - that is the turn in the story.

questions.ask: Do you think Bob should have shared the bun? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason, like the bug was hungry too, or the bun was Bob's to begin with.
